label: run133 cc steam coupling
definition: run131 keeper recipe re-run with the combined-cycle steam-turbine outage coupling: a CC combustion turbine's unit-outage derate now carries its allocated HRSG-steam share (CT_nameplate*(1+sumCA/sumCT)) so a downed CT derates its turbine plus the steam it fed, instead of leaving the CA steam turbine orphaned and fully online. Detection is window-neutral (same outage windows; only the derate magnitude deepens, e.g. Wolf Hollow II 29%->50%). [7c] operating-shape gate PASSES every class/year and per-class TWh holds; the deeper derate lifts the 2023 >$200 tail toward actual but raises 2024/2025 annual LMP ~$5-6 vs run131 (partly offsetting the load-resource credit) — under review before adoption. (PROBE)
